The M6.1 quake on 6 November 2026 (UTC) was near **Hasaki, Japan**, offshore in the Kanto region, southeast of the coast. Search results put it about 144–156 km SE of Hasaki, depending on the source.

- **USGS figures** (as quoted by Defcon Level): 144 km SE of Hasaki, 10:39 UTC on 6 November, depth 29 km. I could not open the USGS page directly to confirm, and the Defcon Level page returned HTTP 403.
- **Other sources:** QuakeMate lists 156 km SE of Hasaki, 10:39 UTC. EarthquakeToday also reports a Hasaki-area M6.1.
- **News:** The Japan Times and others say it struck at 7:39 pm local time (10:39 UTC), was shallow, was felt near Tokyo, and did not trigger a tsunami alert.
